title: Arbitrum Open House São Paulo: Online Buildathon
description: The Arbitrum Foundation's next online buildathon, hosted on HackQuest: 115,000 USDC across an Overall track, a Promising Products track and milestone grants. At least 1 of 3 prizes in each track is reserved for a project building on Robinhood Chain. Existing projects are welcome. Registration opened on HackQuest on Nov 2, 2026; submissions run Feb 8 to Mar 1, 2027.
reward: 115,000 USDC prize pool: Overall 40,000 / 20,000 / 10,000; Promising Products 7,000 / 5,000 / 3,000; up to 30,000 USDC in milestone-based grants
summary: 115,000 USDC in prizes · submissions Feb 8 to Mar 1, 2027
opens_note: Submissions run Feb 8 to Mar 1, 2027; registration is open on HackQuest since Nov 2, 2026, and the requirements are not published yet.
rules: Online buildathon. HackQuest lists registration from Nov 2, 2026 to Mar 1, 2027, submissions from Feb 8, 2027 03:01 UTC to Mar 1, 2027 02:59 UTC, and rewards announced Mar 8, 2027 17:00.
Your project must be deployed on an Arbitrum chain to qualify, for example Arbitrum Sepolia, Arbitrum One or Robinhood Chain.
At minimum 1 of 3 prizes in the Overall and Promising Products tracks is reserved for a project building on Robinhood Chain (and 1 of 3 for one building on Arbitrum).
Bring an existing project or start from scratch. Build with Solidity or with Stylus (Rust).
All prizes are subject to development-tied milestones. Grants are milestone-based and case by case; selection isn't guaranteed.
Submission requirements are not published yet.
